domain.title: Sleep, Circadian Rhythm & Fatigue
domain.outcome: Explain sleep fundamentals and persistent-fatigue assessment without substituting a supplement for diagnosis.
coverageGaps: Acquire topic-specific authoritative sources and qualified reviews; no scientific evidence ingested.
